Purpose: Uncertainty of per-config mean over seeds
Interpretation: Half-widths are wide (10-22% for success) -> low precision from 10 seeds.

Formula / Method: percentile CI from 10,000 resamples of the seed means
Interpretation: Bootstrap and t-CI agree, supporting robustness of the interval estimates.

Formula / Method: Shapiro-Wilk W on each config's 10 seed-means
Interpretation: success/reward ~90% normal; optimality_ratio/excess_cost non-normal -> non-parametric primary.

Formula / Method: one-way repeated-measures ANOVA; partial eta^2 = SS_treat/(SS_treat+SS_err)
Interpretation: No success/reward effect; optimality_ratio effect exists in factorial model.

Formula / Method: Friedman chi^2 = 12/(nk(k+1)) sum R_j^2 - 3n(k+1); Kendall W
Interpretation: Confirms no rank difference in success/reward across algorithms.

Formula / Method: OLS y ~ algo*per*noisy + seed, Type-II SS; partial eta^2
Interpretation: Seed dominates (eta^2~0.20); Noisy & Algo x Noisy significant for optimality_ratio.

Formula / Method: Wilcoxon signed-rank (exact); paired t as secondary
Interpretation: No pair survives Holm correction on any metric.

Formula / Method: Cohen's d_z = mean(d)/sd(d); Cliff's delta; rank-biserial r
Interpretation: Effects are small/negligible on success/reward; up to medium for Noisy on optimality_ratio.
Holm applied within each metric's 6 pairwise / 3 enhancement contrasts.
